# ExternalRuntimeTransport v0.1.0 - Table of Contents

Shared execution-surface substrate for local subprocess, SSH exec, and guest-bridge placement.

  - [Overview](https://external-runtime-transport.hexdocs.pm/overview.md)

  - [Execution Surface Contract](https://external-runtime-transport.hexdocs.pm/execution-surface-contract.md)

  - [Examples](https://external-runtime-transport.hexdocs.pm/examples.md)

## Modules

- [ExternalRuntimeTransport](https://external-runtime-transport.hexdocs.pm/ExternalRuntimeTransport.md): Shared execution-surface substrate for process placement.
- [ExternalRuntimeTransport.Command](https://external-runtime-transport.hexdocs.pm/ExternalRuntimeTransport.Command.md): Generic transport-level command invocation.
- [ExternalRuntimeTransport.ExecutionSurface](https://external-runtime-transport.hexdocs.pm/ExternalRuntimeTransport.ExecutionSurface.md): Public execution-surface contract for process placement and transport routing.
- [ExternalRuntimeTransport.ExecutionSurface.Adapter](https://external-runtime-transport.hexdocs.pm/ExternalRuntimeTransport.ExecutionSurface.Adapter.md): Internal behaviour for execution-surface adapters owned by the core.

- [ExternalRuntimeTransport.ExecutionSurface.Capabilities](https://external-runtime-transport.hexdocs.pm/ExternalRuntimeTransport.ExecutionSurface.Capabilities.md): Typed transport-family and per-session execution-surface capabilities.

- [ExternalRuntimeTransport.ExecutionSurface.Registry](https://external-runtime-transport.hexdocs.pm/ExternalRuntimeTransport.ExecutionSurface.Registry.md): Internal registry of built-in execution-surface adapters.

- [ExternalRuntimeTransport.LineFraming](https://external-runtime-transport.hexdocs.pm/ExternalRuntimeTransport.LineFraming.md): Incremental newline framing for stdout and stderr stream handling.

- [ExternalRuntimeTransport.ProcessExit](https://external-runtime-transport.hexdocs.pm/ExternalRuntimeTransport.ProcessExit.md): Normalized process exit information shared by the runtime and provider profiles.

- [ExternalRuntimeTransport.TaskSupport](https://external-runtime-transport.hexdocs.pm/ExternalRuntimeTransport.TaskSupport.md): Small task helpers shared by the runtime and transport layers.

- [ExternalRuntimeTransport.Transport](https://external-runtime-transport.hexdocs.pm/ExternalRuntimeTransport.Transport.md): Behaviour for the raw subprocess transport layer.
- [ExternalRuntimeTransport.Transport.Delivery](https://external-runtime-transport.hexdocs.pm/ExternalRuntimeTransport.Transport.Delivery.md): Stable mailbox-delivery metadata for transport subscribers.
- [ExternalRuntimeTransport.Transport.Info](https://external-runtime-transport.hexdocs.pm/ExternalRuntimeTransport.Transport.Info.md): Snapshot of a long-lived transport's execution-surface metadata and IO contract.

- [ExternalRuntimeTransport.Transport.Options](https://external-runtime-transport.hexdocs.pm/ExternalRuntimeTransport.Transport.Options.md): Normalized startup options for the raw transport layer.

- [ExternalRuntimeTransport.Transport.RunOptions](https://external-runtime-transport.hexdocs.pm/ExternalRuntimeTransport.Transport.RunOptions.md): Validated options for synchronous non-PTY command execution.

- [ExternalRuntimeTransport.Transport.RunResult](https://external-runtime-transport.hexdocs.pm/ExternalRuntimeTransport.Transport.RunResult.md): Captured output and normalized exit data for one-shot non-PTY execution.

- Exceptions
  - [ExternalRuntimeTransport.Transport.Error](https://external-runtime-transport.hexdocs.pm/ExternalRuntimeTransport.Transport.Error.md): Structured transport error with a normalized reason and debugging context.
